personality.description: This person is intellectually curious and enjoys exploring unusual ideas, often experimenting with new approaches while keeping just enough structure to stay on track. They tend to be somewhat selective and strategic in their habits, but their high sensitivity to stress can make them revisit problems repeatedly and second-guess decisions. In moral dilemmas, they usually think independently and may favor outcomes that protect their own interests, while remaining alert to hidden motives and questioning others' intentions. In group discussions, they speak with mixed ease: sometimes energetic and inventive, but often guarded, skeptical, and direct, especially when they feel challenged or pressured.
